# Juneau — LLM Reference

React component library for AI chat interfaces. Streaming-first, adapter-based, themeable.
Package: `juneau` | CSS: `import 'juneau/dist/style.css'`

---

## QUICKSTART

```tsx
import { JuneauProvider, AiSidebar, createSseAdapter } from 'juneau';
import 'juneau/dist/style.css';

// Point at your SSE-streaming backend endpoint
const adapter = createSseAdapter('/api/chat');

export function App() {
  return (
    <JuneauProvider>
      <AiSidebar adapter={adapter} />
    </JuneauProvider>
  );
}
```

That's the minimum. Everything below is optional customisation.

---

## ADAPTER — THE ONLY REQUIRED CONCEPT

Juneau never calls AI APIs. You provide an adapter. Three options:

### Option 1 — createSseAdapter (recommended, covers OpenAI/Anthropic proxies)

```ts
import { createSseAdapter } from 'juneau';

const adapter = createSseAdapter('/api/chat');

// With auth:
const adapter = createSseAdapter('/api/chat', {
  getHeaders: async () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer ${await getToken()}` }),
});

// With custom body:
const adapter = createSseAdapter('/api/chat', {
  getBody: ({ messages, context }) => ({ messages, model: 'gpt-4o', stream: true }),
});

// With custom SSE parser (if backend doesn't use OpenAI format):
const adapter = createSseAdapter('/api/chat', {
  parseEvent: (data) => {
    try {
      const json = JSON.parse(data);
      return json.text ? [{ type: 'text', text: json.text }] : [];
    } catch { return []; }
  },
});
```

Default `parseEvent` reads OpenAI's `choices[0].delta.content` format automatically.

### Option 2 — createFetchStreamAdapter (NDJSON / raw chunked backends)

```ts
import { createFetchStreamAdapter } from 'juneau';

// Default: expects newline-delimited { text: "..." } or { done: true } JSON
const adapter = createFetchStreamAdapter('/api/chat');

// Plain text chunks:
const adapter = createFetchStreamAdapter('/api/chat', {
  parseChunk: (chunk) => chunk ? [{ type: 'text', text: chunk }] : [],
});
```

### Option 3 — Custom adapter (implement the interface directly)

```ts
import type { AiBackendAdapter } from 'juneau';

const adapter: AiBackendAdapter = {
  async *sendMessage({ messages, context }) {
    const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ messages }),
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
    const reader = res.body!.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      yield { type: 'text', text: decoder.decode(value) };
    }
    yield { type: 'done' };
  },
};
```

### Stream events the adapter yields

```ts
type AiStreamEvent =
  | { type: 'text';  text: string }                                      // text chunk, accumulated into bubble
  | { type: 'part';  part: AiTablePart | AiProposalPart | AiErrorPart }  // rich UI block, appended as-is
  | { type: 'done' }                                                      // stream finished
  | { type: 'error'; message: string }                                    // stream failed
```

### mockAdapter — for development only

```ts
import { mockAdapter } from 'juneau';
// Responds to keywords: "show"/"table" → table, "suggest"/"proposal" → proposal card,
// "help" → capabilities, "error" → error. No backend needed.
```

---

## COMPONENTS

### JuneauProvider — required wrapper

```tsx
<JuneauProvider
  theme={{ colorPrimary: '#1d4ed8', colorAccent: '#7c3aed', fontFamily: '"Inter", sans-serif' }}
  labels={{ sidebarTitle: 'Ask AI', sendMessage: 'Send' }}
>
  {children}
</JuneauProvider>
```

### AiSidebar — self-contained chat panel (owns state internally)

```tsx
<AiSidebar
  adapter={adapter}                          // required
  title="AI Assistant"                       // overrides sidebarTitle label
  context={{ pageId: 'invoices', entityId: 42 }} // forwarded to every adapter.sendMessage call
  icon={<MyIcon />}                          // replaces brain icon in header + avatars
  actions={[                                 // toolbar buttons; [] to hide toolbar
    { icon: <AttachIcon />, label: 'Attach', onClick: openPicker },
  ]}
  sendIcon={<SendIcon />}                    // replaces paper-plane icon
  onProposalConfirm={(id, payload) => {}}    // called when user confirms a proposal card
  onProposalCancel={(id) => {}}
  className="my-sidebar"
  style={{ width: 380 }}
/>
```

### AiChat — headless chat body (you manage state via useAiChat)

Use when embedding chat in your own layout.

```tsx
const chat = useAiChat({ adapter });

<AiChat
  messages={chat.messages}
  input={chat.input}
  isLoading={chat.isLoading}
  error={chat.error}
  onInputChange={chat.setInput}
  onSend={chat.sendMessage}
  onStop={chat.stop}                         // shows stop button while streaming
  onProposalConfirm={chat.confirmProposal}
  onProposalCancel={chat.cancelProposal}
  assistantIcon={<MyIcon />}
  actions={[]}
  placeholder="Ask anything…"
/>
```

---

## useAiChat HOOK

```ts
const chat = useAiChat({
  adapter,             // required
  context,             // optional — forwarded to adapter on every call
  onProposalConfirm,   // optional (id, payload) => void
  onProposalCancel,    // optional (id) => void
});

chat.messages            // AiMessage[] — full conversation
chat.input               // string
chat.setInput            // (value: string) => void
chat.sendMessage()       // sends current input as user message
chat.sendMessageWithText('text') // send programmatically without touching input state
chat.sendGreeting('hint')        // assistant speaks first — no user bubble shown. hint sent as system message to adapter
chat.stop()              // abort in-flight stream, keep messages. no error state — stream just ends where cut
chat.isLoading           // boolean — true from send until stream ends
chat.isConnecting        // boolean — true from send until FIRST token arrives. use for "Connecting…" UI
chat.error               // string | null
chat.reset()             // clear all messages + abort stream
chat.confirmProposal(id, payload)
chat.cancelProposal(id)
```

### sendGreeting — how contextHint flows to the adapter

`sendGreeting(hint)` sends hint as `messages[0]` with `role: 'system'`. No user bubble shown.

```ts
// Component:
useEffect(() => { chat.sendGreeting('User opened Invoices page. Greet briefly.'); }, []);

// Adapter receives:
async *sendMessage({ messages }) {
  const hint = getMessageText(messages[0]); // role === 'system'
  // forward as system prompt to your backend
}
```

### Auth patterns

```ts
// Bearer token:
createSseAdapter('/api/chat', {
  getHeaders: async () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer ${await getToken()}` }),
});

// Session cookie same-origin — no config needed, browser sends automatically:
createSseAdapter('/api/chat');

// Session cookie cross-origin — write custom adapter:
const adapter: AiBackendAdapter = {
  async *sendMessage({ messages }) {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/chat', {
      method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ messages }),
    });
    // stream…
  },
};
```

### Reading message text — use getMessageText, don't dig into parts

```ts
import { getMessageText } from 'juneau';

const lastUser = [...messages].reverse().find(m => m.role === 'user');
const text = lastUser ? getMessageText(lastUser) : ''; // plain string, all text parts joined
```

---

## RICH MESSAGE PARTS

Emit rich blocks from the adapter alongside text:

### Proposal card (confirm / cancel action)

```ts
yield {
  type: 'part',
  part: {
    type: 'proposal',
    proposal: {
      id: 'delete-item',           // returned to onProposalConfirm
      title: 'Delete this item?',
      description: 'Cannot be undone.',
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',      // optional, falls back to labels.proposalConfirm
      cancelLabel: 'Keep',         // optional, falls back to labels.proposalCancel
      payload: { itemId: 42 },     // anything — you get it back in onProposalConfirm
    },
  },
};
```

### Data table

```ts
yield {
  type: 'part',
  part: {
    type: 'table',
    columns: ['Name', 'Amount', 'Status'],
    rows: [
      { Name: 'Item A', Amount: '$1,200', Status: 'Paid' },
      { Name: 'Item B', Amount: '$840',   Status: 'Pending' },
    ],
  },
};
```

Text parts are rendered as **markdown** (via react-markdown, XSS-safe). Bold, lists, code blocks, tables all work.

---

## THEMING

```tsx
<JuneauProvider theme={{
  colorPrimary:        '#1d4ed8',  // send button, user bubble
  colorAccent:         '#7c3aed',  // header bg, proposal confirm, avatar
  colorSurface:        '#ffffff',  // cards, sidebar, input bg
  colorSurfaceRaised:  '#f4f4f6',  // page bg, table headers
  colorBorder:         '#e8e8ec',  // borders
  colorTextPrimary:    '#000000',
  colorTextSecondary:  '#474747',
  colorTextMuted:      '#474747',
  colorTextFaint:      '#9090a0',  // empty states
  colorTextInverse:    '#ffffff',  // text on dark bg
  colorAssistantAvatar:'#FF49A4',  // avatar circle
  radiusSm:            '6px',
  radiusMd:            '8px',
  radiusLg:            '12px',
  fontFamily:          '"Inter", sans-serif',
}}>
```

All keys optional. Only specified keys override defaults. Scoped to provider subtree.

---

## LABELS / i18n

```tsx
import { juneauCs, juneauEn } from 'juneau'; // built-in locales

<JuneauProvider labels={juneauCs}>           // full Czech locale
<JuneauProvider labels={{ sidebarTitle: 'Ask AI', sendMessage: 'Send' }}> // partial override
```

Label keys: `sidebarTitle`, `clearConversation`, `inputPlaceholder`, `sendMessage`, `stopMessage`,
`typingMessage`, `connectingMessage`, `emptyStateText`, `emptyStateHint`,
`proposalConfirm`, `proposalCancel`, `errorDismiss`,
`actionAddFile`, `actionQuickActions`, `actionNew`, `actionHistory`, `actionRules`

---

## EXPORTED TYPES AND UTILITIES

```ts
// Adapter
AiBackendAdapter, AiAdapterInput, AiStreamEvent
AiStreamTextEvent, AiStreamPartEvent, AiStreamDoneEvent, AiStreamErrorEvent

// Adapter factories
SseAdapterOptions, SseEventParser
FetchStreamAdapterOptions, FetchChunkParser

// Messages
AiMessage, AiMessageRole, AiMessagePart
AiTextPart, AiTablePartType, AiProposalPart, AiProposal, AiErrorPart

// Hook
UseAiChatOptions, UseAiChatReturn

// Provider
JuneauTheme, JuneauLabels

// Components
AiInputAction

// Utilities
getMessageText(message: AiMessage): string  // extracts plain text from a message, joins all text parts
consumeStream(iterable, onEvent, signal?)    // iterate a stream manually with abort support
delay(ms: number): Promise<void>            // used internally in mockAdapter
```

---

## ARCHITECTURE NOTES (for generating code correctly)

- `AiSidebar` = `AiChatHeader` + `AiChat` + owns `useAiChat` internally. Use when you want a plug-and-play sidebar.
- `AiChat` = message list + input + error banner. No state. Parent calls `useAiChat` and passes props. Use for custom layouts.
- `useAiChat` = all state and streaming logic. No JSX. Use for fully custom UIs.
- `context` prop on `AiSidebar` / `useAiChat` is forwarded as `input.context` to every `adapter.sendMessage` call — use it to pass page-level data without polluting the message history.
- Text chunks are accumulated — multiple `{ type: 'text' }` events merge into one `AiTextPart`. Don't yield one event per character.
- Always yield `{ type: 'done' }` at the end of a successful stream. Omitting it is fine but the loading state won't clear until the readable stream closes.
- `sendGreeting(hint)` sends a system message to the adapter and streams the response as an assistant-only message. No user bubble is added to the conversation. Good for proactive page-load summaries.

---

## SECURITY

- No API keys ever touch Juneau — keys live in your backend, not the adapter.
- Markdown rendered via react-markdown — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, safe against XSS.
- No persistence — conversation lives in React state only.
